name: Enadoline
summary: Enadoline (developmental code name CI-977) is a drug which acts as a highly selective κ-opioid agonist.

pharmacology.text: Enadoline (developmental code name CI-977) is a drug which acts as a highly selective κ-opioid agonist. It was studied as a potential analgesic, but abandoned because of the dose-limiting effects of dysphoria, which could be expected from a κ-opioid agonist.
